decision_rule: Use the complete six-scenario suite exactly as generated; do not tune or select by test correlation.
purpose: Distinguish native-window coordinate aggregation from the constant-rate simulation regime used to train and validate ReLERNN.
relernn_model_rule: Reuse each scenario's first completed validated corrected-default ReLERNN model without retraining.
scoring_rule: Pearson correlation after averaging each method and the known constant test-map truth in exact complete ReLERNN native windows.
test_map_rule: For each frozen source region, use one constant recombination rate equal to that source region's length-weighted map mean.
